distinction: Current TabM instead of historical PLE trunk is an architecture interaction, not a previously untested airport-head mechanism. Historical penalty was fixed 0.1. Neither a trunk substitution nor removing the penalty establishes new information or positive headroom.

decision: Do not fit or perform a second heterogeneity census under this novelty claim. Retain prior negative and its limitation: reused Jan/Jul development data, one matched network, no universal claim for all architectures.
operations: Static source/result review only; no new labels, inference, fitting, or score calculation.
